remarks: This beautiful Modern Farmhouse is designed with both comfort and style in mind, for a lifestyle of LUXURY living! This "TO BE BUILT" 4BRs 3.5BAs home is located in a prestigious enclave of fine residences in North Stamford, on a quiet cul-de-sac. Nestled on 2 lush acres offering a bucolic natural setting and plenty of privacy. It features gorgeous living spaces with an array of luxury amenities to personalize your home. The first floor offers 10 ft ceilings, open-plan chef's kitchen w/butlers pantry, dining and family room provide ample space for entertaining guests and hosting gatherings, with easy access to the large deck and yard. 1st floor guest suite with full bath, office, powder room, mudroom & storage. The second floor offers Primary suite w/spa bath, sitting area, 2 addt'l BR's and a versatile flex space with terrace which can be used as a 5th BR, playroom, gym or office. This home offers everything you can think of to create lasting memories with family and friends. Conveniently located near fine dining, shopping, theaters, parks, golf, hiking, beaches, and everything the vibrant City of Stamford has to offer with easy access to train, airport and Hwys! Enjoy nearby Greenwich and the quaint towns of Pound Ridge/Bedford, NY. Perfect year-round home or an amazing weekend retreat! Less than 1 hour to NYC! Ask about upgrades, now offering Geothermal and Solar Systems. Land can be purchased separately $395K. Note: Taxes are for the land only.
